macros.name: compressionWidth
macros.doc: The \compressionWidth value is the maximum width that a single span may have in any diagram.

macros.name: dirrel
macros.doc: \dirrel draws a schema diagram for one or more directed (nucleus-satellite) relations.

macros.name: refr
macros.doc: You may refer to any given unit from any part of your document using the \refr command.

macros.name: relnamebgcolor
macros.doc: \relnamebgcolor contains the name of the background color of relation names.

macros.name: relnamecolor
macros.doc: \relnamecolor specifies the name of the text color of relation names.

macros.name: rl
macros.doc: To mark a relation name such as Evidence or Justify in your document, use the \rl command.

macros.name: rstsegment
macros.doc: rstsegment defines a terminal-level minimal discourse unit: it is meant to contain normal text.

macros.name: source
macros.doc: An additional command is \source, which takes one argument. This usually identifies the exact source of the sample, e.g. an identification number in the corpus used.

macros.name: terminalWidth
macros.doc: The \terminalWidth value is the maximum width that a single span may have in any diagram.

envs.name: rhetoricaltext
envs.doc: To give examples from a corpus, you can use the rhetoricaltext environment.
